groups.name: Jhang + Toba Tek Singh
groups.review_note: Approved only as a two-district union. Shorkot 126 and Pir Mahal 132 rural locality names and acreages match across years; available locality codes agree. All other Table 1 tehsil retrospective counts are unchanged; opposing 893-person adjustments stay inside this union. The exact cause of that adjustment and individual full-indicator allocation remain unverified.

groups.name: Kachhi + Nasirabad
groups.review_note: Approved only as a two-district union. Twelve report-listed localities match by name and acreage from Bhag/Kachhi to Landhi/Nasirabad. Published district totals and areas reconcile for the union. Report adjustment 1763 differs from Table 1 adjustment 1932; three locality population dashes remain missing and no individual-district allocation is estimated.

id_policy: Project IDs allocated once in this reviewed register; never reuse. DDV identifies a census publication version, DDG a statistical comparison grouping, neither an official legal district code.

issues.detail: Restored both districts through joint area DDG-0130. The 893-person opposing adjustment is confined to Shorkot/Pir Mahal in Table 1; all 258 published rural localities match by name and acreage. Cause of the retrospective adjustment remains unknown. No separate comparable education allocation or corrected census cell is asserted.

Restored both districts through joint area DDG-0131. Twelve localities move from Bhag to Landhi within the pair. Report adjusts 1763 people versus 1932 in Table 1 (difference 169), and adjusted report areas fail union conservation by 4 sq km. Joint source district counts are summed without estimating any individual allocation; source disagreements remain visible.
Administrative report uses 774878 for 2017; final source Table 1 and summed retrospective Table 1 give 784711. Use report for membership only.
Report lists Surab adjusted 208982; Table 1 has 208493. Whole Kalat/Surab union reconciles to 412058; component allocations from report are not used.
Report page 64 claims no district changes; specific page 65 table documents Keamari creation. Use specific table and Table 1 closure.
2023 Table 1 TANDO AHYAR and Table 13 TANDO ALLAHYAR are explicitly linked to one version; original source IDs remain intact.
Statistical publication-unit crosswalk only. No polygon overlay, present-day map certification, legal effective-date determination, or village-level allocation.
